enable_ssh_support.description: Enable SSH agent support (gpg-agent implements ssh-agent protocol)

disable_scdaemon.description: Disable scdaemon (smart card daemon); disables smartcard operations

allow_loopback_pinentry.description: Allow clients to use loopback pinentry (e.g., for non-interactive signing)

no_allow_external_cache.description: Prevent pinentry from using external cache (e.g., KDE/KWallet, GNOME keyring)

no_allow_mark_trusted.description: Disallow clients from marking keys as trusted in trustlist.txt

no_user_trustlist.description: Ignore user trustlist and use only the global trustlist (/etc/gnupg/trustlist.txt)

use_standard_socket.description: Use standard socket (since GnuPG 2.1, no-use-standard-socket is deprecated and has no effect)

pinentry_timeout.description: Pinentry timeout in seconds (0 = no timeout; pinentry may use its own default)

default_cache_ttl.description: Default passphrase cache TTL in seconds

default_cache_ttl_ssh.description: Default SSH key cache TTL in seconds

max_cache_ttl.description: Maximum passphrase cache TTL in seconds

max_cache_ttl_ssh.description: Maximum SSH key cache TTL in seconds

min_passphrase_nonalpha.description: Minimum number of digits or special characters required in passphrase

check_passphrase_pattern.description: Path or filename (relative to /etc/gnupg if no slashes) of passphrase pattern file

check_sym_passphrase_pattern.description: Path or filename (relative to /etc/gnupg if no slashes) of symmetric passphrase pattern file

max_passphrase_days.description: Maximum days before passphrase must be changed (0 = disable expiration)

s2k_count.description: S2K iteration count (0 = use auto-calibrated value)

s2k_calibration.description: S2K calibration time in milliseconds (0 = use compiled-in default)

listen_backlog.description: Listen backlog size for pending socket connections

extra_socket.description: Path for extra socket; use /dev/null to disable

log_file.description: Path to log file (use 'socket://' to log via systemd socket)

pinentry_invisible_char_list.description: List of characters to use for hiding input in pinentry (UTF-8); one per line in config. Commonly one entry: '*'.

auto_expand_secmem.description: Allow Libgcrypt to expand secure memory; optional size in bytes (rounded up to 32 KiB)
